mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, it is a pleasant 80 degrees with clear skies out at Badger Prairie County Park, and the current moon phase is a Waning Gibbous with an air quality index of 51.

The city has provided updates on the Verona Cemetery, where you can now purchase plots through a new application process, and they have also launched a rain barrel rebate program to help residents save on their stormwater utility costs.

There is plenty to do, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by multiple trivia nights tomorrow at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, and don't forget the Farmers Market this Tuesday.
In our weekly police report, on July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in an O W I arrest after discovering a vehicle being driven without taillights and on a flat tire.
You are going to love today's flavor of the day, Chocolate Covered Strawberry, available at our local Culver's until they close at 10 PM tonight.
